reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing Git status interface for DeepSeek Harness sessions: it adds a header pill and popup/management view showing branch, dirty counts, ahead/behind, recent commits, and changed files, with controls to refresh, stage, discard, and commit. Evidence shows these capabilities are scoped to the active session’s working directory and implemented via host-side Git subprocess operations rather than a standalone coding or search utility.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在会话界面显示当前仓库的 Git 状态信息（分支、脏文件计数、ahead/behind、提交与变更文件），并在弹窗中支持刷新、暂存、撤销与提交文件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that shows Git status in the session UI (branch, counts, ahead/behind, commits, changed files) and provides popup controls to refresh, stage, discard, and commit changes.

capabilities: Displays repository status and change summaries in the web session header and popup.
Executes host-side Git commands for status, staging, unstaging, discard, and commit actions.
Per-session context resolution via session ID for working-directory-scoped operations.
